items.question: What services does Umira Sinergi Global provide?
items.answer: Umira Sinergi Global provides integrated design and build services, including architectural design, structural engineering, MEP systems, construction works, renovation, and project management for villas, residential buildings, commercial spaces, and infrastructure projects.

items.question: Do you handle projects from design to construction?
items.answer: Kami menghadirkan solusi inovatif dan tangguh dalam konstruksi sipil dan arsitektur, menciptakan ruang yang bertahan lama.

items.question: How do you ensure quality and safety during construction?
items.answer: Quality and safety are our top priorities. Each project is supervised by experienced engineers and site teams, supported by structured quality control procedures, HSE standards, and regular progress monitoring throughout the construction process.

items.question: How can I start a project with Umira Sinergi Global?
items.answer: You can start by contacting our team through the Contact Us page. Shate your project details, location, and requirements, and our team will arrange a discussion or site visit to provide the most suitable solution.

AboutDetail.title: Umira Sinergi Global.
AboutDetail.visionText: To become a globally competitive company that prioritizes quality and sustainability, brings broad benefits to society, and upholds Islamic principles as the foundation of success and blessings.
mission: Integrating the principles of honesty, trustworthiness (Amanah), and transparency into all aspects of the business to build trust with customers, partners, and the wider community.
Delivering high-quality services and products with cost efficiency and on-time delivery, guided by the values of excellence (Ihsan) and blessings in every business process.
Creating a positive social impact, including through community empowerment programs and corporate social responsibility.
Managing the business with a strong focus on occupational health and safety, environmental friendliness, and sustainability, in line with the concept of public benefit (Maslahah).
Complying with Sharia principles in all business activities to uphold integrity and spiritual consciousness (Taqwa).
values: Ikhlas, Istiqomah, Ihsan: Sincerity in seeking Allah's pleasure, consistency in truth and goodness, excellence in every endeavor
Rahmah: Mercy and Kindness of Heart
